DISTRICT NO. 11,
EL PASO COUNTY, COLORADO
/s/ Mary Wierman
Secretary
fiscal year (commencing July 1, 1996 and ending June
1997) after the issuance of the Notes.
It is anticipated that CUSIP identification numbers will
be printed on the Notes, but neither the failure to print
such number nor any error with respect thereto shall
constitute cause for failure or refusal by the purchaser to
accept delivery of and pay for the Notes in accordance with
the terms of the Official Bid Form and this Official Notice
of Sale. All expenses in relation to the printing of the
CUSIP numbers on the Notes shall be paid by the District.
The District will furnish the executed Notes, a certified
transcript of legal proceedings, a No-Litigation Certificate
and the approving legal opinion.
Legal matters incident to the authorization and issuance
of the Notes are subject to approval by Holme Roberts & Owen
LLC, Denver, Colorado, Bond Counsel, whose approving opinion
on such matters is expected to state in substance that the
Notes are valid and binding special obligations of the
general fund of the District payable solely from ad valorem
taxes on real and personal property previously levied,
investment proceeds on such taxes, and proceeds of the Notes
to the extent not required for the payment of duly budgeted
current expenses, received by the District and credited to
its general fund in the current fiscal year after the
issuance of the Notes. The opinion of Bond Counsel is
further expected to state in substance that the Notes are
enforceable according to their terms, except to the extent
such enforcement is limited by the bankruptcy and other laws
affecting the enforcement of creditors' rights, by the
reasonable exercise of the sovereign police power of the
State of Colorado, and by the exercise of the powers
delegated to the United States of America by the federal
Constitution.
Bond Counsel has assumed no responsibility to make
independent verifications or confirmations of the statements
made in the Preliminary Official Statement and the final
Official Statement or otherwise in connection with the sale
of the Notes.
The opinion will further provide that interest on the
Notes is excluded from gross income for federal income tax
purposes and from Colorado income tax under existing laws as
presently enacted and construed.
The Preliminary Official Statement has been deemed final
by the District for purposes of Rule 15(c)2-12 of the
Securities Exchange Commission, subject to revision,
amendment, and completion in a final Official Statement to
the extent such revision, amendment and completion is
permitted under Rule 15(c)2-12.
The successful bidder will be furnished with up to twenty-
five copies of the Official Statement within seven (7)
business days from the date of award of sale of the Notes.
Additional copies will be made available at the purchaser's
expense. The District assumes no responsibility or
OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
This Official Notice of Sale does not alone constitute an
invitation for bids but is merely notice of sale of the
Notes described herein. The invitation for such bids is
being made by means of this Official Notice of Sale, the
Official Bid Form and the Preliminary Official Statement.
Colorado Springs School District N0. 11
El Paso County, Colorado
Tax Anticipation Notes, Series 1996
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that on Wednesday, the
11th day of September, 1996,
at 11:00 A.M., Denver time, in the offices of Dain Bosworth,
Inc. (the Financial Advisor'') at 1200 17th Street, Suite
2200 in Denver, Colorado 80202, the Financial Advisor, on
behalf of the Board of Education (the Board'') of Colorado
Springs School District No. 11, El Paso County, Colorado
(the District''), will receive and the Deputy Treasurer of
the District, on behalf of the Board, will open bids, and
will sell to the best bidder Tax Anticipation Notes, Series
1996, in the principal amount of $22,750,000 (the
Notes'').
The Notes shall be issued only as fully registered Notes
without coupons, dated as of the date of issuance, in
denominations as may be determined by the Deputy Treasurer,
and shall mature on June 30, 1996, with interest due and
payable on this date.
The Notes will be delivered in Denver, Colorado, or at any
other place at the request and expense of the purchaser. The
funds to be used by the purchaser for payment for the Notes
shall be available for the District's immediate use on the
date of delivery of the Notes.
Notes will be awarded on the basis of the bid resulting in
the lowest net interest cost, which is defined as the total
amount of interest to accrue from the date of issue to the
date of maturity. Bids must be submitted at par, or par plus
a premium. The interest rate should be stated in multiples
of one-hundredths of one percent. No more than one interest
rate shall be bid for the maturity.
Bids must be without condition or reservation.
The Notes are issued in fully registered form. Principal
and interest on the Notes will be payable to Cede & Co., as
the nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New
York, which will act as depository for the Notes. Such
payments will then be distributed to the participating
members of the Depository Trust Company and by such
participating members to the Beneficial Owners of the Notes.
The Notes are issued in anticipation of the receipt by the
District of ad valorem taxes on real and personal property
previously levied, investment proceeds on such taxes, and
proceeds of the Notes to the extent not required for the
payment of duly budgeted current expenses, received by the
District and credited to its general fund in the current
obligation for the distribution or delivery of any copi
the Official Statement to anyone other than the purchaser.
Ratings on the Notes have been applied for from Moody's
Investors Service and Standard & Poor's Corporation. The
District will cause bidders to be notified of the assignment
of ratings by Munifacts wire on or about September 10, 1996.
Prospective bidders may also obtain such information by
contacting the Financial Advisor at (303) 595-1204. The
District will pay all costs of issuance.
Bids should be submitted to the Financial Advisor, no
later than 11:00 A.M., Denver time, on September 11, 1996,
by facsimile: (303) 595-1220 or 595-1221. All bids will
remain confidential.
The District reserves the right to reject any and all bids
and the right to waive any defect or irregularity in any bid
submitted.
Information concerning the proposed issue of Notes may be
obtained from Dain Bosworth, Inc., 1200 17th Street, Suite
2200, Denver, Colorado 80202, the Financial Advisor of the
District.
THIS NOTICE IS GIVEN by order of the Board of Education of
Colorado Springs School District No. 11, El Paso County,
Colorado, as of the 28th day of August, 1996.
(From The Bond Buyer)
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
